name: birdsights
description: BirdSights root helper — install and run the Node/Express backend and React/Vite frontend together with one command. The two-terminal method (server and client separately) still works.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm run dev"
